acceptanceCriteria: Initialize canonical fixture and compare actual inventory read bounds against owning intent limits for queue, policy, ticket and release paths.
Determine required contract and fix only demonstrated discrepancy while preserving evidence-file bounds and namespace identity.
Retain boundary/overflow regression evidence, independent review and native completion.
body: Suspected inventory-bound discrepancy from #494 actual264. At DD8 baseline inventory fileEntry calls intent.BoundFor with archive namespace intent/queue.json, but intent/store.go:118 accepts queue.json and intent-relative tickets/releases. Thus inventory falls back to MaxEvidenceBlobBytes; #494 preserves exact effective behavior. Full journal audit applies its own stricter bounds, so authority bypass NOT_DEMONSTRATED. New borrowed-metadata fixture initially failed an assumed queue bound, then confirmed existing fallback; /private/tmp/c494-audit-code/focused/focused.stdout and focused/review/REVIEW.md retain evidence. Installed Core163 Tasks202. Dedup BoundFor zero at2473.
title: Investigate archive-path inventory BoundFor fallback
